title: Gibson Flatwound Electric Guitar Strings, Light Gauge

long_description.body:
Developed under the direction of Gibson’s Master Luthiers, Gibson Flatwound Electric Guitar Strings start with a hex-shaped, tinned steel core for strength and are finished with a flat, stainless steel ribbon wrap. This construction leaves very little space in between wraps, producing a rich, mellow tone while reducing noise from finger movement. Used exclusively on all archtop guitars built in the Gibson Custom facility in Nashville, Gibson Flatwound Electric Guitar Strings are designed for smooth tone and a refined playing feel.



The hex-shaped, tinned steel core provides durability, while the flat, stainless steel ribbon wrap brings the timeless warm voice of vintage Gibson guitars into the present
Precision-polished for authentic flatwound feel and sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers on our prestigious archtop guitars from the
Gibson Custom facility
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .011, .015, .022w, .030, .040, .050
Light Gauge: .012, .016, .024w, .032, .042, .052
